CustomField.description: This Form Template's own logo alt text, used in place of the org default from the Global Styles tab. Optional; leave it blank to use the org default. Banners read it through the Logo Alt Text formula field.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional. What a screen reader says for this form's logo, usually the organization's name. Leave blank to use the org default.
CustomField.label: Logo Alt Text Override
